purpose: Versioned bounded metadata-format diagnostic and resource-ownership repair, without broadening the command-content gate.
compressed_scope: Exactly eleven direct-child regular *.jsonl.zst files; no recursion, symlinks, or user-supplied paths.
selection: Buffer-only structural envelope selector requires exact top-root type=response_item and direct payload type=function_call or custom_tool_call, with approved exec/exec_command name, before UTF-8 decode or JSON.parse. Root keys limited to timestamp/type/payload; direct payload keys limited to type/call_id/name/arguments/input/status. Unknown or escaped envelope keys/type/name values, nested command-looking outputs, user/assistant/output envelopes and wrong tools are skipped without decoding. Date is exact root timestamp prefix 2026-10-02T; approved formal-candidate/provenance marker also required. Skipped envelope count is explicit.
exports: Filename, timestamp, tool name, explicit recordtype, has_invocation heuristic (script or python -m src.data.build_formal_candidate_space_v2) and selected clean metadata path/--output-root/--candidate-root snippets only. No whole commands, environment, credentials, outputs or result fields.
path_caveat: Historical denied-path strings are metadata hints only and may be exported; their files are never accessed. Protected B root and checkpoint/sensitive path strings are suppressed.
format_coverage: Strict unescaped ASCII envelope keys and type/name values only, with arbitrary JSON whitespace/key ordering. Escaped envelope keys/types and extra metadata keys are outside coverage and counted as skipped; missing matches are not history-wide absence. At most 100 retained deduplication identities. Diagnostics additionally count known direct-envelope shapes without weakening the command gate.
payload_field_gate: Before any UTF-8 decode/JSON.parse: function_call requires quoted arguments and forbids input; custom_tool_call requires quoted input and forbids arguments. call_id if present must be a quoted string or null. status if present must be null or the fixed string completed/in_progress/incomplete. Objects, arrays, unknown status values and unused command fields are rejected without decoding.
coverage: Freeze opened file sizes and scan only initial prefixes; ignore appends. Oversized lines counted and skipped. Bound-hit files and incomplete prefixes explicit; no global history absence claim.
prior_execution_observation: R1 emitted a PASS-looking packet with zero command matches, then a generic FAIL packet and exit 2. Actual post-output failure cause is unknown; double-close is a hypothesis, not established evidence. R1 artifacts and two-line output are preserved.
cleanup: FileHandle objects own input descriptors. Await all handle cleanup before emitting any terminal packet. Cleanup failure emits only one bounded FAIL packet; no success is emitted before cleanup.
diagnostic: For marked raw lines in the same date/file/byte scope, Buffer-only structural inspection exports aggregate known root.type/direct payload.type/toolname enums plus predefined direct envelope key enums and value kinds only. Every unknown/escaped/arbitrary identifier key maps to UNKNOWN_KEY without decoding or exporting its bytes. Allowed key enums are timestamp/type/payload/call_id/name/arguments/input/status/id/role/content/output/summary/encrypted_content/recipient/channel/phase. No argument/input/output/content/status values, nested body keys, arbitrary strings, or full commands exported. No diagnostic JSON.parse or UTF-8 decoding. Strict command envelope gate unchanged.
execution_policy: Review-gated single versioned diagnostic run only; no automatic retry and no expanded date/path window. Implementation tests do not open actual history files.
